description: Open library of labeled facts: look up a fact, check a claim, search P vs NP attempts. Read-only; nothing you send is stored.

tools.name: lookup_fact
tools.title: Look up a proven fact
tools.description: Search the library of machine-checked facts. Compact by default (claim start, label, receipt link); set detail true for the full wording.

query.description: Words about the fact, e.g. "root theorem"

detail.description: Full claim, what checked it and what is not proven

tools.name: check_claim
tools.title: Check a claim
tools.description: Find the claims in a text and check the ones plain code can: arithmetic (PROVEN or FALSIFIED), primes, unit conversions. A famous unsolved problem (P vs NP, the Riemann hypothesis) is OPEN. Anything else is NOT CHECKED, which never means false, with a next step.

text.description: The sentence or answer to check, e.g. "2+2=5"

tools.name: search_attempts
tools.title: Search past P vs NP attempts
tools.description: Search the list of past attempts at P vs NP. Rows are labeled CHECKED, REASONED or NOT TRACED. A match is a warning sign, never a verdict.

query.description: Words about your idea, e.g. "linear programming TSP"

annotations.title: Search past P vs NP attempts
